purpose: Which hosts a profile applies to and which governed roles it may hold. Skill trigger meaning lives only in FIRING-MATRIX.generated.json; this file never repeats or narrows a trigger, veto, dependency, or reference.
seat_rules: Seat capability and model identity are separate.
A transported `SEAT:` field never changes the already established seat of another active surface.
Receiving a dispatch authored by an ORCHESTRATOR never makes the receiving surface an ORCHESTRATOR.
ADVISOR is an advisory role outside the governed seats and grants no implementation, approval, commit, push, publication, routing, or canonical-mutation authority.

hosted-coordination.note: Equivalent roles receive the same governed-role doctrine on both hosts.

local-builder-reviewer.note: Local execution and review surfaces. They use the same matrix; only host wiring differs.

applies_to: any other outside model or host
external-host-adapter.note: The host or its local agent implements its own adapter and proves conformance against the matrix. It may report a capability exception; it may not silently change canonical trigger semantics.

known_capability_exceptions.observed: The Antigravity CLI YAML frontmatter parser rejects the canonical `unslop` SKILL.md frontmatter (`skills.go` logs `failed to parse frontmatter: yaml: line 2`). The installed bytes are the current canonical bytes.
known_capability_exceptions.required_report: BLOCKED for `unslop` effectivity on this host, with this exception id. The canonical skill is not altered by matrix generation.

applies_to: ChatGPT hosted account and Project configuration
chatgpt-hosted-application.note: ChatGPT cannot mutate its own hosted configuration from a chat. Application and firing qualification are separate ORCHESTRATOR-routed tasks. Nothing in this pack changes ChatGPT account or Project configuration.

manifest_surfaces_without_profile.substrate8-repository: The source repository surface. It receives the generated routing pointer, not a host profile.
